d1125e4ad07d1d57.text: Ooh, a mystery snack! But not quite what I ordered. Again?

269fd13ee5c1224f.speaker: narrator

7224155ae68d6761.text: Earn 4 Birthday Bricks to wear this! Play in the Story Tower and the Whispering Woods.

7b7ad94d04c09a5a.speaker: narrator
7b7ad94d04c09a5a.text: Here come your Birthday Bricks, stacking up into a cake!

8fcc3d725aeb4ec5.speaker: dad
8fcc3d725aeb4ec5.text: Luna, you fill our whole family with light, laughter, and big ideas. Watching you grow up is the best part of every single day.

b47ff8946a884c03.speaker: mom
b47ff8946a884c03.text: We love your stories, your kindness, and the way you care for the world around you. Never stop imagining, sweet girl. We are so proud to be your mom and dad.

a2c289ccb6e5727d.speaker: dad
a2c289ccb6e5727d.text: Hi Luna! Welcome to the Music Stage. Tap the pads and make some music!

ebd5ca7b5f0064c0.speaker: dad
ebd5ca7b5f0064c0.text: Follow the glowing keys, Luna. Tap the lit one!

606ada4204be3755.speaker: dad
606ada4204be3755.text: You earned a Birthday Brick! The whole band is so proud of you!

db39ec1a9736678f.speaker: darian
db39ec1a9736678f.text: Boom boom! I am on the drums!

1458e57f9f304acc.speaker: julian
1458e57f9f304acc.text: Cool keys, Luna! I am on the keyboard!

c49eef4b9678bb3a.speaker: mom
c49eef4b9678bb3a.text: Strum strum! I have my tambourine!

cfaca3ec6283b117.speaker: rudolph
cfaca3ec6283b117.text: Woof woof! We love the xylophone!

e9bd742c7aa2e461.speaker: dad
e9bd742c7aa2e461.text: Happy birthday to you! That was beautiful, Luna!

ce741824f509b94b.speaker: dad
ce741824f509b94b.text: You hopped all the way across Island Hop!

76b2e42e7b2a6acd.speaker: dad
76b2e42e7b2a6acd.text: What a lovely Tea Time Twirl!

9db13d08079f5ef5.speaker: julian
9db13d08079f5ef5.text: Welcome to my lab, Luna! Pick an experiment. Do two for a Birthday Brick!

0d7567151a8f3ea6.speaker: julian
0d7567151a8f3ea6.text: This is red cabbage juice. Stir it with your wand, then add something!

93d1f1b01565595f.speaker: julian
93d1f1b01565595f.text: Nice stirring! Now add lemon or baking soda.

a1a12b23385aa71a.speaker: julian
a1a12b23385aa71a.text: Ooh, pink! Lemon is an acid, and acids turn red cabbage juice pink!

235c3b418008f4ee.speaker: julian
235c3b418008f4ee.text: Ooh, green! Baking soda is a base, and bases turn red cabbage juice green!

372f1c718ab2d238.speaker: julian
372f1c718ab2d238.text: Stir first, Luna. Hold the flask or tap it!

912f76a962149062.speaker: julian
912f76a962149062.text: Pick something, then guess: will it sink or float?

7c22fd6b1801caaa.speaker: julian
7c22fd6b1801caaa.text: Ooh, good thinking! Here it goes...

4f490fe03173f19b.speaker: julian
4f490fe03173f19b.text: A solid brick is packed heavier than the water around it, so it sinks!

2fb1008b89334c22.speaker: julian
2fb1008b89334c22.text: Cork is full of tiny air pockets, so it is lighter than water and floats!

3ec40c3af782c2db.speaker: julian
3ec40c3af782c2db.text: Apples have air inside, so they are lighter than water and float!

4df640091c187992.speaker: julian
4df640091c187992.text: A coin is metal, which is packed much heavier than water, so it sinks!

7237722d88f645d8.speaker: julian
7237722d88f645d8.text: The duck is hollow and full of air, so it is lighter than water and floats!

4142118b5865d9d8.speaker: julian
4142118b5865d9d8.text: Stones are dense, which means very heavy for their size, so they sink!

4fe7e266974e7455.speaker: julian
4fe7e266974e7455.text: Tap to add fuel bricks to the rocket. Then LAUNCH!

7c4be65b39157568.speaker: julian
7c4be65b39157568.text: Add at least one fuel brick first!

5cf5defb54064ce6.speaker: julian
5cf5defb54064ce6.text: 1 fuel brick! Three, two, one, blast off!

9d6de68bfa272098.speaker: julian
9d6de68bfa272098.text: 2 fuel bricks! Three, two, one, blast off!

0bf0979661eabe95.speaker: julian
0bf0979661eabe95.text: 3 fuel bricks! Three, two, one, blast off!

02bdb755b80674d6.speaker: julian
02bdb755b80674d6.text: 4 fuel bricks! Three, two, one, blast off!

13cdc8581d5af5cb.speaker: julian
13cdc8581d5af5cb.text: 5 fuel bricks! Three, two, one, blast off!

84fd64586378760b.speaker: julian
84fd64586378760b.text: More fuel means more push, so the rocket goes higher! The parachute slows it down on the way back.

9d69b2c11821b8c6.speaker: julian
9d69b2c11821b8c6.text: We will speed up time! Tap to grow sugar crystals on the string.

c84a908107914b42.speaker: julian
c84a908107914b42.text: Sparkle! A new day of growing!

7f4ee6967955ac69.speaker: julian
7f4ee6967955ac69.text: As the water dries up, called evaporation, the sugar stays behind and builds crystals!

8a913f21c4ae1b9e.speaker: julian
8a913f21c4ae1b9e.text: Help the seed grow! Give it water, light, and soil. Any order!

0206db418a7514c8.speaker: julian
0206db418a7514c8.text: Good! What else does the seed need?

62f10fb027088e5d.speaker: julian
62f10fb027088e5d.text: Pop! It sprouted! Seeds need all three: water, light, and soil.

84572005e7d47c3a.speaker: julian
84572005e7d47c3a.text: Coupon challenge! Match my mystery potion three times and win the Video Game Day coupon!

1dc69f3b3b5f0cc0.speaker: julian
1dc69f3b3b5f0cc0.text: You are a potion master! Last one!

ca4770cc74e5a227.speaker: julian
ca4770cc74e5a227.text: The lab is glowing like an arcade! You did it, Luna! Something is buried near the Science Lab!

86219ac64d5cf6f9.speaker: julian
86219ac64d5cf6f9.text: Bloop! Even I did not expect that one.

c77effb0775c3203.speaker: julian
c77effb0775c3203.text: Oh no, the goo is escaping! Hee hee!

14847c8b9fac5ed4.speaker: julian
14847c8b9fac5ed4.text: That is not a potion, that is a swamp party!

0c00891aaa43010f.speaker: julian
0c00891aaa43010f.text: I need a purple potion! What goes in?

26656910a8a538cb.speaker: julian
26656910a8a538cb.text: Hint: try red berry and blue flower!

4dd7894376990248.speaker: julian
4dd7894376990248.text: I need a green potion! What goes in?

025b7de462925659.speaker: julian
025b7de462925659.text: Hint: try blue flower and yellow lemon!

b7eaaee60cb7cc67.speaker: julian
b7eaaee60cb7cc67.text: I need a orange potion! What goes in?

20e195606ac3f5b1.speaker: julian
20e195606ac3f5b1.text: Hint: try red berry and yellow lemon!

13cefa3718344914.speaker: julian
13cefa3718344914.text: I need a pastel pink potion! What goes in?

9af3061cb5fed075.speaker: julian
9af3061cb5fed075.text: Hint: try red berry and white salt!

d89d7d87c39d9de8.speaker: julian
d89d7d87c39d9de8.text: I need a pastel blue potion! What goes in?

a0bcdb889d0f42cd.speaker: julian
a0bcdb889d0f42cd.text: Hint: try blue flower and white salt!

e8cac33b268238e8.speaker: julian
e8cac33b268238e8.text: I need a pastel yellow potion! What goes in?

97fdffe0171e0003.speaker: julian
97fdffe0171e0003.text: Hint: try yellow lemon and white salt!

d3ac5c98de398e39.speaker: julian
d3ac5c98de398e39.text: I need a sparkly purple potion! What goes in?

126fff24204ee93b.speaker: julian
126fff24204ee93b.text: Hint: try red berry and blue flower and glitter!

72ebf54586b02f06.speaker: julian
72ebf54586b02f06.text: I need a sparkly green potion! What goes in?

f5caf69063cc014d.speaker: julian
f5caf69063cc014d.text: Hint: try blue flower and yellow lemon and glitter!

4e3973089d0f78ad.speaker: julian
4e3973089d0f78ad.text: I need a sparkly orange potion! What goes in?

445e82940e9cbb55.speaker: julian
445e82940e9cbb55.text: Hint: try red berry and yellow lemon and glitter!

5f061d3384d54748.speaker: darian
5f061d3384d54748.text: Whoa! Where did the ball go?

344de943a960248c.speaker: darian
344de943a960248c.text: What a rally! Great job, Luna!

d21482f20ae62a89.speaker: darian
d21482f20ae62a89.text: Super Rally! You did it, Luna!

f7227dc6e8673525.speaker: narrator
f7227dc6e8673525.text: Something is buried near the Tennis Court…

a210264f751474dc.speaker: narrator
a210264f751474dc.text: Bricks build the birthday cake. Beat a zone's Coupon Challenge to dig up a Daddy-Daughter Date coupon!

622dfbe3986a452c.speaker: luna
622dfbe3986a452c.text: Mmm, tea for the host too!

949a9135f4ae6ed2.speaker: luna
949a9135f4ae6ed2.text: A treat for the host? Yes, please!

45df93bc4cb501f1.speaker: narrator
45df93bc4cb501f1.text: The forest friends say thank you!
